name: two-sided-features
title: Two sided features
description: A platform explained to both sides: what buyers get and what sellers get, mirrored around a centre line, each side with benefits and an action of its own.
docs: Pass sides, a pair of audiences: each has a label ("For hosts"), a heading, benefits (an icon, a title and a description) and a cta. The benefits sit on the same rows across the centre rule, so each pair reads straight across, and both sides get the same button, so neither reads as an afterthought. On a narrow block the sides stack with a labelled divider between them (the word is labels.and). The heading is centred by default; align="start" sets it from the left. The heading of each side is always set smaller than the title, at level 3 as at level 2, so the title stays the focal point. The block has no state and renders on the server.
